title: Protospace validation suite: machine-checked algebra for emergent Dirac/Weyl matter, geometry, and induced gravity
description: Executable verification harness backing the protospace programme manuscript "The protospace programme: from a discrete analogue to a substrate whose slow-gradient limit yields induced 3+1 general relativity." Pairs each algebraic, combinatorial, and structural claim with a test in sympy (exact symbolic identities), z3 (finite SMT), or numpy/scipy (finite numerical diagnostics). Covers the matter algebra (Clifford, Lorentz, Dirac/Weyl, chirality), graph-local chiral balance, emergent-geometry diagnostics (spectral dimension, cone criterion, low-mode metric, U(1) holonomy), and the new gravity layer (torsion-free spin connection and curvature, the Lichnerowicz R/4 coefficient, and the Sakharov-Volovik induced-gravity skeleton). Reports 218 passing checks.
